title: Blog article frontmatter
description: Machine-checkable contract for Blog article frontmatter. Rendering, RSS, sitemap, structured data, and locale routing all derive from it; article metadata is never hardcoded in components.

title.description: Answer-oriented title. Keep it under about 60 characters (12-28 CJK characters); avoid company voice.

description.description: One or two sentences of reader value, used verbatim as the meta description and RSS excerpt.

lang.description: BCP 47 language tag; must be one of the locales declared in the site specification.

permalink.description: Stable lowercase path segment, shared by every locale version of the article. For a CJK title, write an English slug by hand; do not transliterate.

translationKey.description: Cross-locale grouping key. All locale versions of one article share it; hreflang and locale switching derive from it.

category.description: Stable topic; the value must come from the categories allowlist in blog.config.json.

publishedAt.description: YYYY-MM-DD. First publication date; do not change it after publishing.

updatedAt.description: Substantive revision date; must not be earlier than publishedAt. Do not bump it for typo fixes.

readingMinutes.description: Leave empty. The build computes it separately for CJK characters and Latin words and fills it in.

author.description: Leave empty to fall back to the default author in blog.config.json.

cover.description: Relative path or absolute URL, used for both Open Graph and BlogPosting.image.

coverAlt.description: Required whenever cover is set; validation blocks the combination otherwise.

draft.description: When true, excluded from listings, RSS, sitemap, structured data, and the production build.

noindex.description: Still renders a page, but stays out of the sitemap and emits robots noindex.

canonical.description: Points at the original source when syndicating; leave empty to use the site URL.

toc.description: Whether to render a table of contents. It is always generated from h2/h3, never hand-written.

cta.description: Key of the end-of-article conversion block, from ctaBlocks in blog.config.json; empty uses the default.

series.description: Series identifier used to link previous and next articles.

related.description: Hand-picked related articles by translationKey; empty falls back to scoring on category and tags.
